facts.fact: Algeria's higher-education ministry says Minister Kamel Baddari discussed with a Chinese delegation on 9 November 2026 the project to establish an AI-dedicated data centre at the National Higher School of Artificial Intelligence (ENSIA), Sidi Abdellah, covering infrastructure, equipment and timeline.

systems.owner: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research

DZA.note: The ENSIA AI data centre is a project under discussion, not a data centre for hire in service.
Document says only 'in accordance with international standards' of a planned facility; no standards membership or adoption stated.
Planned facility only; no nationally owned data centre for hire in service stated.
